```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s07_b_ALDER_map/"
```

# Load data

```{r}
# Load ALDER results
dates_full <- readRDS("../results/s07_ALDER/alder_results_all.RData")

# Subset to `ref A`$Borneo and `ref B`$Mozambique Chopi
dates <- dates_full %>%
  filter(
    `ref A` == "Borneo" &
      `ref B` == "Mozambique_Chopi"
  )

# Load KML
#kml_data <- sf::st_read(dsn = "../data/raw/data_input/Data_with_pierron.kml")
#kml_data <- sf::st_transform(kml_data, crs = 29702)
# Add names
#kml_data$Name <- c("Merina", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsimisaraka",
#                   "Betsileo", "Diego", "Temoro", "Vezo", "Mikea",
#                   "Mikea", "Mikea", "Mikea", "Mikea", "Mikea", "Mikea")


kml_data <- readRDS("../data/raw/data_input/sampling_locations_with_pierron.rds")


kml_data <- kml_data %>%
  mutate(
    x = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
    y = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]
  )
```


```{r}
# match kml_data$Name and dates rownames
matching <- match(kml_data$Name, as.character(dates$`test pop`))

# add admixture date and std_err to kml_data
kml_data$date <- dates[matching, "admixture_date"]
kml_data$std_err <- dates[matching, "CI"]


ours <- rep(0, 5)
pierron <- rep(1, 9)
sample <- c(ours, pierron)
kml_data$sample <- sample

kml_data <- kml_data[order(kml_data$Name), ]

# Add plot shape
kml_data$shape <- c(1, 3, 7, 15, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 19, 21, 23)

# add admixture date in years (gen time 30 years)
kml_data$years <- paste(
  round(kml_data$date * 30, 0),
  "\u00b1",
  round(kml_data$std_err * 30, 0), "BP"
)


labels_data <- kml_data %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  reframe(
    x = mean(x),
    y = mean(y),
    date = years,
    geometry = st_centroid(st_union(geometry))
  )

# Mikea has multiple locations, remove duplicates and leave one row to label
labels_data <- labels_data[!duplicated(labels_data$Name), ]
```

# Create map

```{r}
# List possibly relevant countries
target <- c("Madagascar", "Mozambique", "Comoros", "Mauritius", "Seychelles", "Mayotte", "United Republic of Tanzania", "Malawi", "Zimbabwe", "South Africa", "Eswatini", "Zambia", "Lesotho", "Somalia", "Kenya", "Ethiopia", "Uganda", "Rwanda", "Burundi", "Djibouti", "Eritrea", "South Sudan", "Botswana", "Namibia", "Angola", "Democratic Republic of the Congo", "Central African Republic", "Republic of the Congo", "Equatorial Guinea", "Cameroon")

# Create an inset of Madagascar
madagascar_inset <- ne_countries(
  country = target,
  type = "map_units",
  scale = 50
)

madagascar_dissolved <- madagascar_inset %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_as_sf()
```

# Plot

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = madagascar_dissolved) +
  geom_sf(
    data = sf::st_as_sf(kml_data),
    aes(shape = Name, color = Name, fill = Name),
    size = 2
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    crs = st_crs(29702),
    xlim = c(-1000000, 1800000),
    ylim = c(1, 2000000), expand = FALSE
  ) + # Laborde projection
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF", color = NA)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 3, 7, 15, 17, 19, 21, 23)) +
  labs(shape = NULL) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = NULL,
    color = "Population",
    shape = "Population",
    fill = "Population"
  ) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = labels_data, force = 4, force_pull = 1,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = date), size = 3,
    nudge_y = 2, segment.color = "transparent"
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  guides()
ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "alder_dates_st_err.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
kml_data$yrs <- as.numeric(unlist(tstrsplit(kml_data$years, " ", keep = 1)))

# Replace kml_data$Name == "Sakalava_Tsimihety" with "Sakalava/Tsimihety"
kml_data$Name[kml_data$Name == "Sakalava_Tsimihety"] <- "Sakalava/Tsimihety"
# Replace kmldata$Name == "Diego" with "Diego Mixed"
kml_data$Name[kml_data$Name == "Diego"] <- "Diego Mixed"

labels_data <- kml_data %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  summarise(
    x = mean(x),
    y = mean(y),
    geometry = st_centroid(st_union(geometry)) # Optional: Keeps geometry if needed
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = madagascar_dissolved) +
  geom_sf(
    data = sf::st_as_sf(kml_data),
    aes(color = yrs, fill = yrs),
    size = 2
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    crs = st_crs(29702),
    xlim = c(-1000000, 1800000),
    ylim = c(1, 2000000),
    expand = FALSE
  ) + # Laborde projection
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF", color = NA)) +
  labs(
    colour = "Admixture Date (years BP)",
    fill = "Admixture Date (years BP)",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  geom_label_repel(data = labels_data, aes(x = x, y = y, label = Name), size = 3, segment.color = 'transparent') +
  guides()
ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "alder_dates_gradient.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```

## Recording R environment

Part of ensuring our workflow is reproducible is to keep track of the R environment.
We will automatically save our R environment into a file called `r_environment.json`.

```{r save-r-environment, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filename_rmd <- "s07_b_ALDER_map.Rmd"
filename_renv <- paste0(
  res_dir, "/renv_",
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filename_rmd)),
  ".json"
)
renv::lockfile_write(renv::lockfile_create(), file = filename_renv)
```
